examples.description: Vary an earlier library image. Replace the asset key with an asset_key from your own earlier result.

description: [paid: $0.04/image] Generate 1-3 variations of a reference image guided by a prompt (FLUX Pro Kontext, context-aware). Pass image_asset_key (an earlier result) or image_url (public https or data:image) plus a prompt describing the change. Each image is stored in this workspace's image library and returned as JSON {images:[{url, asset_key, download_url?, width, height}], price, next} plus a preview; never a provider link. A result with no download_url says why in download_url_unavailable. Refuses: SIMPLER_MEDIA_INPUT_MISSING (pass one image input), SIMPLER_MEDIA_FOREIGN_KEY (use this workspace's asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_URL_REFUSED (use https, data:image or an asset_key), VALIDATION_ERROR on an empty prompt, INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS (add credits), SIMPLER_IMAGE_PROMPT_REFUSED names the label (sexual, minor, real_person or other_unsafe): rewrite the prompt without it, for example no real person's name or likeness; SIMPLER_IMAGE_PROMPT_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE (the safety check is down, nothing charged: retry later); SIMPLER_IMAGE_OUTPUT_FLAGGED (the output failed the content check and was refunded: change the prompt); SIMPLER_IMAGE_OUTPUT_SCAN_UNAVAILABLE (outputs cannot be checked right now, nothing charged: retry later). A partial result lists refunded outputs in output.withheld. To edit a SPECIFIC region use image.inpaint; for whole-image restyle use image.style_transfer. NEXT: pass images[0].asset_key to image.upscale or image.cut_background.

image_asset_key.description: The reference image, as the asset_key of an earlier image result for this workspace (edit-projects/<tenant>/... or images/<tenant>/...). A key from another workspace is refused (SIMPLER_MEDIA_FOREIGN_KEY).

image_url.description: The reference image: a public https URL, a data:image/...;base64 URL, or the url/url_path of an earlier image result (max 20MB; PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; SVG is refused). Pass this or the matching *_asset_key, not both.

preview_format.description: Preview block after the JSON, at most 384px on the long edge and never charged: png, jpeg or none. Left out, a PNG result gets a png preview and a JPEG or WebP result a jpeg one. A result with no preview says why in preview_unavailable.

prompt.description: How to vary the image (max 1500 chars).

request_ref.description: Optional idempotency key (1-64 chars: letters, digits, . _ : -). Retrying with the same request_ref and the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result at $0 with replayed: true; the same request_ref with different arguments is refused (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_CONFLICT), and so is a retry whose first result was deleted since (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_RESULT_DELETED): send a new request_ref to run it again.
